thread:
samir: Quick heads-up: hitting a reproducible issue in samplekit when jsonMode + function calling + token refresh collide. Logs attached.
aj: what's the symptom?
samir: network capture shows function_call.arguments becomes a JSON string (double-encoded) after auth refresh:
```
{"type":"function_call","name":"submit_order","arguments":"{\"items\":[{\"id\":\"sku-10\",\"qty\":2}],\"meta\":{\"user\":\"u2\"}}"}
```
samir: arguments should be an object. Happens only when retry triggers an auth refresh.
maria: seen on JS samplekit; python SDK seems okay because it sends bytes earlier. parity issue.
jen: where is retry logic? core http client or sample app?
aj: in sdk-core http client. Suspect retry middleware stringifies for logging and then transport stringifies again on resend.
kevin: can repro locally by forcing 401 on the first call.
samir: quick hack: marking request._alreadySerialized stops the second stringify in samplekit — confirms double-serialize.
aj: plan: add guard in transport (skip stringify if body is string or flagged). I'll open a small PR with an integration test that simulates token refresh and checks wire payload.
maria: also add a docs note: transport expects final body as string/bytes; middleware must not mutate original JS object.
jen: UX: if jsonMode+fncall sees arguments as a string, surface a clearer error pointing to retry/serialization path.
kevin: agreed. action items: aj -> PR & test, platform -> audit py/js transport parity, devex -> README blurb. Keep open until PR merges.
samir: thanks all — ping me for repro workspace.
